deviations: Verification's run_all.py line lists the expected PASS order as 'E1, E2-offline, B2, E3, E4 (in file-name order)', but that literal sequence is not alphabetical: test_b2_governor.py sorts before test_e1_executor_guard.py ('b'<'e'). The actual output (B2, E1, E2-offline, E3, E4, ALL PASS (5 files)) IS the correct file-name order the parenthetical names; confirmed with a bare sorted(glob(...)) call. Treated as a mis-copied example in the brief's own prose, not a defect: there is no file I am allowed to rename (test_b2_governor.py is the mandated name) or edit (run_all.py is run A's file, outside this run's Files list) that would change it. Main session should confirm the parenthetical, not the list, was intended.

splice_block.py's --start/--end 'occurs more than once' check counts occurrences over the WHOLE file, not just after the start marker (the brief did not fully specify the search scope). Verified correct on both real splices via a dry-run against scratch copies before touching .claude/AI_ROUTING.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md.

status.py's budget_line(), when no claude block exists at all, replaces 'Claude 5h ... tier ...' per spec but also drops the trailing '| age Nm' segment entirely (age is only defined relative to a claude block's updated_utc). Not exercised by a B2.7 check in that exact combination; self-certified pending main-session confirmation.

status.py's rules_now() joins EVERY applicable sentence independently (weekly>=90 AND weekly>=75 both fire when weekly>=90, since the brief lists them as separate bullets, not an elif chain). No B2.7 check exercises the combined text at weekly>=90; self-certified pending confirmation this is the intended joining, not a mutually-exclusive tier pick.

budget-gate.py's 5-hour deny reason uses five_hour_resets_utc when set, else falls back to weekly_resets_utc, else 'unknown' (the brief did not specify a fallback for an absent five_hour_resets_utc). My own B2.7 fixtures always pass --five-hour-resets explicitly, so this fallback path is unverified by a check; noted for the main session.
